03
characterization

Baseline then integrate dried-powder PLQE

Baseline then integrate dried-powder PLQE. Zolix OmniFluo with calibrated Labsphere integrating sphere; measure 365 nm baseline, then single crystals or dried nanocrystal powder. The 89.3% absolute PLQE belongs to dried nanocrystal powders measured in the integrating sphere at 365 nm, not an explicitly measured colloid. Missing fields: drying protocol, mass.
